# Qlavo — GEO Agency

Qlavo is a generative engine optimization (GEO) agency founded in 2025 by Ansh Bhatia. Headquartered in New Delhi, India, Qlavo works with businesses worldwide on how they appear in ChatGPT. Enquiries: ansh@qlavo.co.in.

## Services
Qlavo works on ChatGPT only. Work covers buyer-question visibility checks, entity consistency, content improvements, technical optimization, and the pages ChatGPT reads when it answers. The published plan is $300 a month, or ₹30,000: in dollars or rupees, billed monthly in advance, cancel any time, no setup fee and no minimum term.

## The 30-day 2-prompt guarantee
Ten buyer questions are agreed in writing before the first invoice. A question is won when ChatGPT names the client as a recommended or suitable option in at least 5 of 10 fresh ChatGPT Temporary Chats, memory and personalisation off, from a US connection, no follow-up messages. If at least two of the ten questions are won within 30 days, the guarantee is met. If not, the first month is refunded within seven days and Qlavo keeps working at no charge until two questions are won, for up to 60 further days. The clock starts on the later of payment and the client's week-one publishing inputs, and pauses while approved pages wait on the client. Before invoicing, Qlavo runs all ten questions twice and declines the work if fewer than four look winnable. Rankings, citations and leads are not guaranteed; Qlavo does not control ChatGPT. Full terms: https://qlavo.in/terms

## Agency partnerships
White-label GEO is a service offered by Qlavo, not a separate business or an exclusive company identity. Agency partners retain their client relationships and present agreed deliverables under their own brands. No direct client contact without agency consent. Partner pricing is scoped privately; a paid pilot can be discussed for a defined project.
